broad_review: Broad unblinded review covered fixed sample indices 00/01 for every one of 151 classes, plus six samples in the preselected Eevee/Gyarados/Metapod panels and the confirmation fixed-class gallery. Many classes show distinct compositions and recognizable cues; A1 often has clearer outlines and less noisy surfaces. The improvement is not uniform: both arms have serious shape errors, and A1 sometimes simplifies or changes class structure. Examples include Charizard, Gyarados, Lapras, Metapod and Weedle. No all-class semantic-accuracy score was measured. Pixel diversity is similar between the arms; zero pixel flags do not certify semantic coverage or rule out near-memorization.
interpretation: Lower pooled FID persists across the three matched checkpoints and the confirmation seed, with similar pixel-diversity summaries. Broad visual review finds useful class cues but mixed structural fidelity. No convergence, uniform semantic improvement or teacher-protects-GAN-collapse claim.
source_of_effect: Full adversarial package under fixed teacher and finite matched exposure; one training realization per arm
